title: Human Treg cell suppressive assays
protocol: Recover the blood sample.
Put 15 ml of Ficoll Hypaque in a 50 ml falcon tube and carefully add 30 ml of blood.
Repeat the process to handle the whole blood sample.
Centrifuge at 400G for 22 minutes without interruption at room temperature.
Recover and pool the PBMC-containing rings into Baxter medium in a 50 ml falcon tube.
Wash and centrifuge at 200G for 13 minutes at 4°C to separate platelets.
Resuspend the PBMC pellet in Baxter medium and count it at 1/100 dilution.
Centrifuge the PBMC at 300G for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Incubate the PBMC with anti-CD25 beads: mix 4.5 x 10^8 cells per ml with 50 µl of beads for 20 min at 4°C in Baxter medium.
Wash and centrifuge at 300G for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend the sample at 2 x 10^8 cells per ml in Baxter medium.
Perform MACS separation using an LS column according to Miltenyi protocol.
Recover the negative fraction (CD25-) containing Teff cells and APCs in a 50 ml falcon tube.
Recover the positive fraction (CD25+) containing Treg cells in a 5 ml falcon tube.
Count both fractions.
Centrifuge about 100-150M cells from the CD25- fraction at 300G for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Incubate them with anti-CD4 beads: mix 1 x 10^8 cells per ml with 10 µl of beads for 20 min at 4°C in Baxter medium.
Wash and centrifuge the sample at 300G for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend cells at a concentration of 2 x 10^8 cells per ml in Baxter medium.
Perform MACS separation using an LS column according to the Miltenyi protocol.
Recover the negative fraction (CD25-CD4-, containing APC) in a 50 mL falcon and the positive fraction (CD25-CD4+, containing Teff cells) in a 5 mL falcon.
Count both fractions.
Centrifuge the CD25-CD4- fraction at 300G for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Incubate 1 x 10^8 cells per ml with 10 μl of each anti-CD14 and anti-CD19 bead type for 20 min at 4°C in Baxter medium.
Wash and centrifuge the sample at 300G for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend cells at a concentration of 2 x 10^8 cells per ml in Baxter medium.
Perform MACS separation using an LS column according to the Miltenyi protocol.
Recover the positive fraction (CD25-CD4-CD14+CD19+, containing APC) in a 5 mL falcon.
Wash APCs in culture medium and centrifuge at 300G for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Irradiate the APCs at 50 Grey.
Wash the APCs in culture medium and centrifuge at 300G for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Count the APC fraction.
Centrifuge the CD25+ fraction at 300G for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Incubate the pellet at a concentration of 5 x 10^7 cells per ml with anti-CD4 PerCP and anti-CD25 PE antibodies for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Wash cells and centrifuge at 300G for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend the pellet at 20 x 10^6 cells per ml, filter the solution, and transfer it into a 5 ml FACS tube.
Sort Treg cells using Aria according to CD4+CD25+IL-7Ra-CD45RA+ for naive Treg cells and CD4+CD25+IL-7Ra-CD45RA- for memory Treg cells.
Wash in PBS and centrifuge Treg cells at 400G for 10 minutes at 4°C after sorting.
Wash the cells with culture medium and transfer them to an eppendorf tube.
Centrifuge at 300G for 5 minutes.
Count both fractions of sorted Treg cells.
Resuspend Treg cells at 1-3 x 10^5 cells per 300 μl.
Prepare a solution of IL-2 concentrate 5X at 1500 UI/ml (final concentration: 300 UI/ml).
Prepare a solution of TNF concentrate 5X at 250 ng/ml (final concentration: 50 ng/ml).
Distribute 300 μl of Treg cells in a 48-well plate.
Add 100 μl of IL-2 or/and TNF to complete the volume to 500 μl.
Incubate at 37°C for 20h to 72h.
Wash Teff cells in PBS and centrifuge them at 300G for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Repeat washing step with PBS.
Incubate Teff cells with 1 uM CFSE at 1 x 10^7 cells per ml in PBS for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Stop the reaction by adding 1/5 volume of FCS for 1 minute.
Wash in complete medium and centrifuge the cells at 300G for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Count the Teff cells.
Resuspend Treg cells at 10^4 cells per 50 μl and make serial dilutions (1 to 2).
Resuspend Teff cells at 10^4 cells per 100 μl.
Prepare TNF concentrate at 4X if needed for a final concentration of 50 ng/ml.
Add anti-CD3/CD28 beads to the Teff cell solution to be at 10^3 beads per 100 μl.
Distribute solutions in U-bottom 96-well plates: Teff cells + beads (100 μl), Treg cells (50 μl), and TNF (50 μl) in duplicate for each condition.
Coat a U-bottom 96-well plate with 0.5 μg/ml of anti-CD3 (100 μl per well) at 37°C for 2 hours.
Resuspend Treg cells at 10^4 cells per 50 μl and make serial dilutions (1 to 2).
Resuspend Teff cells at 10^4 cells per 50 μl.
Mix APC with Teff cell solution at equal volume.
Prepare TNF concentrate if needed for a final concentration of 50 ng/ml.
Wash the plates two times with 150 μl of PBS without letting the plate dry.
Distribute Teff cells + APC (100 μl) in appropriate wells in duplicate for each condition.
Distribute Treg cells (50 μl) in appropriate wells in duplicate for each condition.
Distribute TNF (50 μl) in appropriate wells in duplicate for each condition if needed.
Resuspend Treg cells at 10^4 cells per 50 μl and make serial dilutions as required.
Resuspend Teff cells at 10^4 cells per 50 μl.
Resuspend APC at 10^5 cells per 50 ul and mix it equally with the Teff cell solution.
Add anti-CD3 to the Teff cells + APC solution to achieve a final concentration of 5 ug/ml.
Prepare a TNF solution concentrated 4X at 200 ng/ml if needed for the final concentration of 50 ng/ml.
Distribute Teffs cells + APC + anti-CD3 (100 μl) in appropriate wells in duplicate for each condition.
Centrifuge the U-bottom 96-well plate at 300g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Incubate cells in PBS+3%FCS with anti-CD4 PerCP antibodies Biolegend (1/100) for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Wash cells in PBS+3%FCS and centrifuge the plate at 300g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend cells in 200 μl of PBS+3%FCS and analyze by FACS.
